mapper.select: SELECT COURSE_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, TAGS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM COURSE_TBL WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}
SELECT COURSE_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, TAGS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM COURSE_TBL WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
